track_a.title: Omitted receipt membership
track_a.explanation: The locker box is grounded correctly. Its recovered field has no receipt section, so one of two membership edges is missing.

track_a.title: Cached Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite
track_a.explanation: Gemini omitted both roles. The reference section assigns Custodian to both fields, and the fixture default supplies Custodian for the prediction. Pickup date has no printed format, so the reference and prediction both have no additional validation.

track_b.title: Recovered slot ID
track_b.explanation: Physical grounding binds the recovered slot field to the locker identifier. Both answers are correct.

track_b.title: Missing pickup date
track_b.explanation: The narrative supplies the date. Omitting it loses one of the two expected answers.
